_comment: Project management workflow schema for actormata. Stages define an FSM; agents.json binds LLM adapters per stage.

intake.label: Intake
intake.description: A new item has been submitted and is awaiting initial triage.

data_collection.label: Data Collection
data_collection.description: Gather enough information to assess the item.
data_collection.question: Review the entity context. Is there enough information to assess this item, or does it need more data? Answer with one of: ready, needs_more_info.

assessment.label: Assessment
assessment.description: Evaluate the item's feasibility, risk, and effort.
assessment.question: Assess this item for feasibility and risk. Should it move to prioritization, or is it fundamentally not actionable and should be rejected? Answer with one of: viable, rejected.

prioritization.label: Prioritization
prioritization.description: Decide whether to activate or defer the item.
prioritization.question: Given current capacity and strategic fit, should this item be activated now or deferred? Answer with one of: activate, defer.

deferred.label: Deferred
deferred.description: Item is parked for future consideration.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Item has been assessed as not actionable.
